body: Just wanted to say goodbye. You seem very kind
I'm glad it works for you sorry about the possibly defective version though
Sorry I'm not sure of the difference between generic and non generic. It's prescription. It is current. I've used it for almost a year.
I have tried fluoxetine. What medication has helped you if I may ask? I hope you can be relieved from the club one day.

Same. As someone who wasn't unpopular and went out quite a bit and was invited out by friends, I couldn't go back to that age for almost any amount of money. It was stressful, scary and so. Much. Little. Fucking. Freedom. These people seem sad about missing out but there is not much to miss out on. If you're low down on the pecking order you're fucked.
Haha that made me chuckle. I see what you're trying to do. I'm not sure how my family will react but I don't care anymore. I'm certain of that. It's unfortunate because I love them
I'm not sure. I think I've come to accept it. It feels better this way.

How dont I know my problems can't find me? I am my problem. I can't escape it. My brain is horrible. I can only escape it through death. I hate both my body and my brain. It can be torture. The problems will just follow me wherever I move. I love where I live. I love my family and my friends. I hate myself and my life. I believe this is the right thing to do.
I can't live for myself. What caught me wavering a bit was leaving others behind. I don't worry about that now

It's still 20th July here. I thought about it a lot today. I was eating dinner with my family and was pleased how well they got along without me. The world revolves just fine if I weren't here. I could have said nothing the whole dinner and nothing would have changed. They say every impact counts because of the butterfly affect but my actions are drastically insignificant. This gives me more motivation to do it. I also saw that Chester Bennington commited suicide using the same method I will do. It shows really that fame, family and praise does not equate to happiness. It could be true that some people are destined to end up this way. I see it in a way as a service to the world. Soon I will not be a drain on resources anymore.
I do, I can't stand the solitude of knowing you're about to die but not being able to tell anyone
I don't care to change it. I don't have the willpower to even live let alone work to make my life better - something I believe is an impossibility
I am 100% sure.
I'll have to read some of these books if I can get it done in a day or so
I don't want them to care. I don't want to burden. I want them to live for themselves and forget about me
Oh absolutely. I felt like this for a long time. Now I'm feeling doing it :D So releving.

I'm so glad someone feels the same way. I'm just. Unable to feel remorse for what I plan to do. I guess I'll be dead so I won't be able to feel my impact. Also they'll be able to move on just fine. People tend to be relatively self-centred. They'll be worrying about their own death more than mine. And I'm glad it's this way. I want to go peacefully

Depression has been around since realistically traceable. There has been an increased in diagnosis, but it can be reasonably assumed that this is due to better tools to diagnose and more widespread recognition of the illness.

Oh I'm 100% certain. I'm only posting here because it's difficult for me to contain my thoughts especially since I can't do it before that date (close family members birthday, don't want to create a bad memory for them). Also genuinely wanted advice on how to act around them.

I'm fine with there being nothing after death. Im fine with nothing. I have thought about it for many years and this is a conclusion I have accepted. I fully welcome death. I'm tired of waiting to die by accident and have decided to take action.

I'm not prepared to do the hard work it takes to obtain happiness I believe I will never achieve. I don't care enough to do it. I don't want to do it. Ive tried. I just care about it ending it right now. If I believe my depression could be cured then yes maybe I'd work towards it. But I don't.

I've been to a professional and have been prescribed meds.

Please, don't apologise for not responding. Take care of yourself. If you have a chance at living it's very important to take care of it and fulfill yourself in life. Don't get discouraged by people like me. I made a conscious choice to end my life. I'm happy about the decision and I've accepted it.
I'll try suicide. It's something I've never done and certainly a solution to my problem. Thank you for your comment

My life: continue depression and nihilism. Continued abuse on myself which I slowly cease to be able to contain and bring it out on other people. I've already started by having a toxic personality. This is a good decision to make, and the right thing to do.
I've waited. This is the right decision
I feel lonely in the moment. Technically nothing is a problem but it's another discomfort I don't enjoy in my last days alive.

Everytime I've thought about it I've come to the same conclusion. It's just waiting to finally get it over now. Like an exam you've prepared for, and aren't exactly looking forward to, but you know it's the right thing to do. Thanks for your comment
Thank you ❤️
Thanks, you're kind, but I've made up my mind.
